system.description:
Cost: 1 Resolve or 1 Wound

Range: Self

Area: 5-space radius, 5-space-line

The destruction caused by Black Flame is not limited to the physical world, and you take advantage of that aspect to burn away spells before they can affect you.

As an Action, you can envelope yourself and any allies within a 5-space-radius of you in a cloak of Black Flames.

Until the start of your next turn, you and your affected allies take 2 less Damage from spells.

Additionally, affected creatures gain bonus dice equal to your Training in Metaphysics to any checks made to resist spell effects. They also gain these bonus dice on any checks they make with the Counteract trait.

If an ally moves more than 5 Spaces away from you, this ability no longer affects them. If they come within 5 spaces of you, this ability affects them as normal.

On your turn, you can spend 1 Resolve or take 1 Wound to sustain this effect.
